title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 14 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 13 March 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Sabaragamuwa, Central and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. A few showers may occur in Eastern province and in Polonnaruwa and Hambantota districts. Mainly fair weather will prevail elsewhere over the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
